feeds.title: Simple Flying
feeds.description: Launched in June 2018. Our goal is to provide a one-stop hub for all the key stories on commercial aviation, sharing the news in a simple, accessible way. We cover all regions, and all aspects of commercial aviation. We're digital first, and all of our content is free to read and access.

feeds.title: The OAG Blog

feeds.title: Plane Talking
feeds.description: Stay ahead of the curve with real-time updates on major airline developments, from fleet expansions to route expansions. Plane Talking provides a comprehensive view of the dynamic landscape, ensuring you're always in the loop about the industry's most significant happenings.

feeds.title: Airport Spotting
feeds.description: Airport Spotting blog by Matt Falcus is the go-to place for finding out the latest news about airport developments, aircraft deliveries, new airline routes, and all things that the aviation enthusiast loves to keep on top of. feeds.title: Mersey Radar

feeds.title: NATS Blog

feeds.title: Leading Edge Aviation Blog
feeds.description: Browse the latest news and blog posts - from exciting expansion plans and industry updates to pilot careers and essential training information, Leading Edge Aviation Blog provides everything to keep readers in the loop. feeds.title: Oxford Aviation Group Blog

feeds.title: Smart Aviation Blog
